(주)케이원 회사소개 — CEO 인사말, 회사개요, 조직도. 통합 시운전: About K1 Co., Ltd. — CEO message, company overview and organization. An integrated commissioning specialist.
K1은 대한민국 최초로 Turnkey Commissioning 수행체계를: K1 is the first company in Korea to establish a turnkey commissioning system — a commissioning specialist for the shipbuilding, offshore and energy industries.
시운전은 프로젝트의 마지막 공정이지만, 그 준비는 프로젝트의 시작부터 이: Commissioning is the last process of a project, but preparing for it must begin the day the project starts.
그렇기에 우리는 프로젝트 초기 단계부터 현장에 참여하여 시운전 준비상태를: That is why we join the site from the earliest project stage, verifying commissioning readiness in advance, carrying out system-by-system commissioning, and staying with our clients through final completion and handover.
현장에서 프로젝트를 수행하며 축적한 경험을 바탕으로 시운전을 보다 체계적: Drawing on experience accumulated in the field, we have consolidated a more systematic way of commissioning into a single proprietary framework — our turnkey commissioning method. Moving beyond the conventional manpower-centred approach, K1 provides an integrated commissioning service that manages every process within one system.
우리의 경쟁력은 인원의 숫자만이 아니라 현장을 이해하는 경험, 기술을 연: Our competitiveness lies not in headcount alone, but in experience that understands the site, an organisation that connects technologies, and the execution to carry a project through to completion.
앞으로도 K1은 대한민국을 넘어 글로벌 조선·해양·에너지 산업에서 신뢰받: K1 will continue to grow beyond Korea into a trusted commissioning partner for the global shipbuilding, offshore and energy industries.
회사를 크게 만드는 것보다 고객이 다시 찾는 회사를 만드는 것이 K1의: K1's goal is not to become a large company, but a company clients come back to.

ISO 기반 품질 절차, JSA·PTW 시스템 운영을 통해 무재해·무결점: Delivering zero-accident, zero-defect projects through ISO-based quality procedures and JSA/PTW systems
Punch 관리, 공정 통제, 품질 문서화, 글로벌 협업을 통한 프로젝트: Integrated management across the project through punch control, schedule control, quality documentation and global collaboration
글로벌 전기 시운전 선도 기업: A global leader in electrical commissioning

고객·파트너·구성원이 같은 방향으로 움직일 수 있도록 열린 태도로 협업하: We collaborate openly so that clients, partners and our own people can move in the same direction, building better outcomes together.

Turnkey Base를 기반으로, 케이원과 케이원오션 두 축이 프로젝트: Built on a turnkey base, K1 and K1 OCEAN deliver the entire project together as two axes.
